description:
Using the WooCommerce 'Bulk Actions' feature in the Products list, mark exactly these three products as 'Featured': 
1. Wireless Bluetooth Headphones (SKU: WBH-001)
2. Organic Cotton T-Shirt (SKU: OCT-BLK-M)
3. Merino Wool Sweater (SKU: MWS-GRY-L)

Navigate to the Products page, select these specific items, and use the 'Edit' bulk action to change their Featured status to 'Yes' simultaneously. Do not edit them one by one.
